# Goalfinity Group

> Goalfinity Group brings together education and career development through two verticals: Goalfinity Careers (career guidance, job-search support and placement services for international students in the USA) and Goalfinity Institute of Professional Studies (career-focused programs in Ahmedabad, India, and online).

## Key pages
- [Home](https://www.goalfinity.co/): Goalfinity Group overview, about, vision, mission and founder's message
- [About](https://www.goalfinity.co/about): About Goalfinity Group, vision, mission and founder Mithil Shah
- [Goalfinity Careers](https://www.goalfinity.co/careers): 4-stage career support for international students in the USA: profile building, job applications, technical and interview support, re-employment support; OPT / STEM OPT guidance
- [Goalfinity Institute](https://www.goalfinity.co/institute): Classroom coaching in Ahmedabad and online programs with placement assistance
- [AI Engineer & Data Science](https://www.goalfinity.co/institute/programs/ai-engineer-data-science): Python, data science, machine learning, generative AI and LLMs
- [Investment Banking & Financial Analytics](https://www.goalfinity.co/institute/programs/investment-banking-financial-analytics): Financial modelling, valuation, equity research, M&A and financial analytics
- [Digital Marketing, Content Creation & AI](https://www.goalfinity.co/institute/programs/digital-marketing-content-ai): SEO, social media, performance marketing, content creation and AI-powered marketing
- [Contact](https://www.goalfinity.co/contact): Enquiry form and office details
